scripts.gate: biome check . && tsc --noEmit -p . && bun run test:bun && bun run test:node && bun run test:deno && bun run build
scripts.build: rm -rf dist && bun build index.ts testing.ts --outdir dist --target node --packages external --splitting && tsc -p tsconfig.build.json
scripts.release: bun run build && mkdir -p release && bun pm pack --destination release
